rows.quote: This research was conducted under approved UK Biobank application 78867 and is covered by the generic ethical approval (REC reference 21/NW/0157).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by an application number (78867; p005 and p007 give the same project ID) and by described procedures (APOE genotypes extracted from imputed BGEN data, p001). No passage names a published GWAS release, accession or citation for the outcome data.
